About J Varshit Diam

A family legacy
shaped under pressure.

Our journey began with a first touch of diamond cutting and grew through patience, courage and hard-earned wisdom. Today, J Varshit Diam stands for trust, honesty and quality.

01 / The founder journey

From Mumbai’s
market to a mission.

Natubhai Laxmanbhai Jasani moved to Mumbai in 1995, where he worked as a broker, observed the trade and absorbed every lesson the market offered. In 1998, he took the first bold step toward his own Diamond Trading Business.

In 2000, J Varshit & Co. began with a small team of four to five people and dreams much bigger than the business itself. Over time, it evolved into J Varshit Diam — stronger, clearer and more rooted.

The company’s purpose is not only financial growth. It is to build a business founded on values, contribute meaningfully to society, protect nature and create relationships that last generations.

02 / The people behind the promise

One family.
One lasting vision.

Founder & Partner · Guidance

Natubhai Laxmanbhai Jasani

Born and raised in Pipardi, Gujarat, Natubhai entered diamond cutting during high school. After learning the trade in Bhavnagar and Mumbai, he began his own diamond trading business in 1998 and established J Varshit & Co. in 2000.

His leadership is rooted in trust, transparency, quality, perseverance and responsibility.

Sales Executive

Rajnish Jasani

Rajnish represents the next layer of the family business, building customer relationships through clear communication, disciplined coordination and a long-term partnership mindset.

His focus is helping every buyer experience confidence from first conversation to final delivery.

Multi-Department Executive

Ghanshyam Jasani

Ghanshyam supports the many connected departments that make the diamond business work, from planning and coordination to consistent execution.

His role reflects the family’s hands-on approach to quality and responsibility.

Upcoming Generation

Varshit Jasani

Varshit represents the upcoming generation of J Varshit Diam, bringing fresh energy and a future-facing perspective to a family-owned business.

The future grows with new ideas while the company’s vision, values and principles remain non-negotiable.
